scope_note: Covers 6 algorithms per the program spec: genetic mining, ACO, PSO, Heuristic Miner, Inductive Miner, ILP Petri-net discovery. All 6 are no_lean_coverage, independently re-confirmed this checkpoint (matches the master ledger built in W4PM-LEAN-GALL-009/009A -- no contradiction, no new Lean coverage found). This checkpoint's real work is a confirmed-live defect fix (ACO core-level degenerate result), not a Lean correspondence harness, since no Lean formalization exists for any of the 6 to bridge to.

ledger_entries.note: stochastic by design (population sampling, tournament selection, crossover, mutation) -- exact correspondence structurally impossible even with full proof coverage; only a convergence-in-probability claim could ever be proven, and none exists in mfact or mfw.

rust_side.rng: locally constructed StdRng::seed_from_u64(42) -- reproducible, but diverges architecturally from the documented support::rng::seeded_rng() single-source convention (a flagged inconsistency, not fixed this checkpoint).
rust_side.tests: wasm4pm/tests/algorithm_correctness.rs:94-161 -- ga_fitness_in_range, ga_convergence_more_generations_never_worse, ga_deterministic_same_seed, ga_output_structure_valid: real structural/behavioral properties, not just 'did not panic'.

ledger_entries.note: stochastic (pheromone-guided Bernoulli edge selection). A DEGENERATE_RESULT (nontrivial input converging to an empty edge set) was already known at the CLI-bridge layer (aco_bridge.rs) -- this checkpoint confirmed the guard did NOT exist at the core-crate level and FIXED it (see below), since any direct caller of discover_aco_algorithm_from_log bypassing the CLI bridge remained exposed.

defect_found_and_fixed.symptom: with low ant_count/iterations (e.g. 5 ants x 5 or 10 iterations, seed 42), every ant's Bernoulli draw can fail to select any edge every iteration, so best_solution legitimately converges to an empty edge set on genuinely nontrivial input -- confirmed LIVE by re-running the existing aco_fitness_in_range/aco_deterministic_same_seed tests, which broke under an initial bare-refusal fix attempt (proving the degenerate case is not hypothetical).
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: wasm4pm/src/genetic_discovery.rs, discover_aco_algorithm_from_log's final result mapping: when best_solution's edge set is empty, fall back to the full observed edge vocabulary (the raw directly-follows relation) rather than either (a) silently returning Some((empty_dfg, fitness)) as before, or (b) returning None outright (which broke existing sanctioned test behavior at this parameter range) -- an honest 'nothing better than the raw DFG was found' answer.
defect_found_and_fixed.new_test: wasm4pm/tests/algorithm_correctness.rs::aco_never_returns_empty_dfg_on_nontrivial_input -- asserts Some(...) implies a nonempty edge set.

rust_side.rng: locally constructed StdRng::seed_from_u64(42) -- same architectural inconsistency noted for genetic-algorithm.

ledger_entries.note: stochastic by design (particle blend/mutation toward pbest/gbest) -- same structural-impossibility-of-exact-correspondence note as genetic-algorithm.

rust_side.rng: locally constructed StdRng::seed_from_u64(42), same architectural inconsistency.
rust_side.degenerate_result_risk: only the input-empty guard exists in core (same shape as ACO pre-fix); no equivalent 'nontrivial input converged to empty result' fallback was added this checkpoint -- flagged, not fixed, since no live test failure demonstrated it as an active (not merely theoretical) risk the way ACO's was.
rust_side.tests: algorithm_correctness.rs:168-210 -- pso_fitness_in_range, pso_convergence_more_iterations_never_worse, pso_deterministic_same_seed: real numeric/structural properties.

ledger_entries.note: nearest Lean candidate is Ledger.lean::validTopologicalSort (DAG validity only, no discovery-specific theorem) -- confirmed insufficient for a carrier map, matches 009's own explicit downgrade.

rust_side.determinism: fully deterministic -- pure frequency-count arithmetic (dep(a,b) = (|a->b| - |b->a|) / (|a->b| + |b->a| + 1)), no RNG.
rust_side.tests: streaming_heuristic.rs:341-404 test_dependency_threshold asserts EXACT edge counts against a hand-computed dependency formula (e.g. assert_eq!(dfg.edges.len(), 0) when weak, assert_eq!(dfg.edges.len(), 2) at threshold 0.7 with computed 0.75) -- real ground-truth structural assertions.

ledger_entries.note: strongest structural candidate for FUTURE Lean work (sound-by-construction cuts) but genuinely unformalized in mfact/mfw today, not merely unmapped -- would require new Lean proof work, not just an encoder, confirmed by 009's own note re-verified this checkpoint.

rust_side.determinism: fully deterministic -- activities pre-sorted before recursion specifically to guarantee reproducible tree structure; flower-model fallback at depth>100 or no-cut-found is an intentional clean give-up path, not a silent-empty-result bug.
rust_side.tests: algorithm_correctness.rs:1068-1116 assert EXACT tree shapes via a tree_shape() helper (e.g. 'sequence(a,parallel(b,c))', 'xor(sequence(a,d),sequence(b,c))', 'loop(a,b)') -- among the strongest ground-truth structural tests of the six.

ledger_entries.note: no ILP/region-theory Lean module found in mfact or mfw. In principle fully provable (region theory is well-established math) but no Lean work exists at all today.

rust_side.determinism: fully deterministic -- NOT a true ILP solve; a deterministic threshold-sweep plus greedy set-cover approximation (discover_optimized_dfg_from_log, lines 481-525), a real terminology-vs-implementation gap worth noting but not itself a defect (the doc comments do not claim a real ILP solver is used).
rust_side.degenerate_result_risk: correctly guarded at the core level already: n==0 || col.trace_offsets.len()<=1 returns an explicit empty-Petri-net/zero-fitness tuple (lines 66-68), not a silent partial success.
rust_side.tests: algorithm_correctness.rs:359-406 -- ilp_transitions_match_activities (assert_eq!(pn.transitions.len(), activities) for exactly 5 known activities), ilp_source_place_has_initial_token, ilp_fitness_and_precision_in_range: real structural assertions tied to known ground truth.

flagged_defects_out_of_scope: genetic-algorithm, ACO, and PSO each construct their own StdRng::seed_from_u64(42) locally in genetic_discovery.rs rather than using the documented support::rng::seeded_rng() single-RNG-source convention -- reproducible today, but architecturally inconsistent; a future refactor to centralize seed control would need to touch 3 call sites.

PSO's core discover_pso_algorithm_from_log has the same core-level-only-input-empty-guard shape ACO had before this checkpoint's fix -- not demonstrated as a LIVE failure the way ACO's was (no existing test broke), so not fixed here; worth a follow-up check with a wider ant/iteration parameter sweep.

ILP discovery's name is a terminology mismatch with its implementation (deterministic threshold-sweep + greedy set-cover, not a true ILP solver) -- not a correctness defect, but worth a doc clarification.
